notes: The first plan-typed run: a chain-only workflow:plan node dispatched under the dispatch driver, sampled from a real headless provider session. No per-workflow context block -- the four nodes (standards-discovery, plan, plan-approval, handoff) live under the frozen workflow: block with node_summaries beside it, the plan-approval gate is answered via file by the dispatching operator, and handoff carries the two emitted values (plan_outcome, plan). Artifacts keep the A4 layout (implementation/plan.md) rather than the artifacts/ flattening the older run fixtures use. Only the two absolute paths (driver.cwd, workflow.source) are pseudonymized; the em dashes and box-drawing characters of the plan were replaced with ASCII.
